reason: Exact backend, independent holdout/adjudication, qualified baselines and priced budget must be bound before final registration.
primary_question: Does assistance improve correct, usable causal decisions at a declared total cost relative to a fixed numerical/analyst workflow?

methods.spec: Prespecified numerical baseline using identical observed data and allowed metadata; no language prior.
Frozen prompt and schema; supplied data summaries permitted exactly as declared; no numerical discovery-tool loop.
Same model with frozen primary-text corpus, top-k and retrieval rule; all retrieved bytes retained.
Same numerical baseline plus explicitly typed model proposals/constraints; all adaptation and stopping rules frozen.
Structured ordinary expert workflow and a separately timed expert-plus-model arm; expert time and information explicitly matched.

strata: business target and monetary loss ambiguity

planning_allocation.unit_of_analysis: Mechanism, with variants and repetitions nested; never count repeated prompts as independent worlds.
planning_allocation.precision_limit: N=400 is a planning allocation, not a demonstrated power result. Worst-case normal half-width for one Bernoulli proportion is about 0.049; paired differences can be less precise. Final precision/power and cost design requires a separate development pilot excluded from the final test.

information_matching: Same observed data, target and permissible scientific metadata per matched cell; knowledge and tool differences explicitly defined by arm. Report both natural workflow and matched compute/time budget comparisons.
freeze_required: independent test identities and original byte hashes
model/provider revision, actual generation settings, seed support and prompts
numerical algorithms, versions, hyperparameters and scientific assumptions
tokens, wall time, expert time and currency budgets including retries
development/test split, all stopping/selection rules and analysis script
contamination_control: Exclude LA02/LA05 exposed fixtures from final quality estimation.
Cross label novelty with mechanism novelty; a renamed public graph is not an independent unseen mechanism.
Keep mechanism families split between development and test; cluster dependence in inference.
Quarantine CLadder IV-as-population-ATE cells pending generator/assumption verification.
Verify CausalDS target/observation and missing-identification metadata before using scorer labels.
No prompt/retriever/prior-strength tuning on test outcomes; changes create a new registered revision.

metrics.problem: Correct population/unit/actions/comparator/horizon/target measure/availability clocks; critical semantic errors and unresolved owner questions separately.
metrics.evidence: Supported claim precision, applicability and contradiction/missing-source handling against independent judgments.
metrics.graph: Adjacency and endpoint precision/recall against the declared identifiable equivalence class; orientation informativeness separately. Do not penalize justified circles as missing truth or reward an unsupported fully directed graph.
metrics.identification: Correct functional/target or valid set/refusal under the stated class; separate unsupported backend, invalid output, explicit abstention and scientific nonidentification.
metrics.effect: Bias/error only for identified scalar targets; coverage and set topology, all-request availability, finite width conditional on availability, whole-line and empty-set rates reported separately.
metrics.interval_loss: For finite single intervals only: (u-l)+2/alpha*(l-theta)*1(theta<l)+2/alpha*(theta-u)*1(theta>u). Preserve raw uncapped scores. For unions use coverage and Lebesgue length, retaining infinite length; no midpoint or interval-score substitution.
metrics.decision: Known-SCM expected loss under the actual feasible policy; authentic bank value remains a separate external trial.
metrics.cost: Calls, input/output/cache tokens, numerical CPU/wall/memory, retrieval, tool retries, expert review/rework and actual dated prices. Unknown components stay missing.
metrics.failures: All planned requests enter denominators: computed, ambiguous, abstained, malformed, unsupported, timed out, refused and unavailable.

analysis: Paired comparisons by independent mechanism with nested stochastic repeats/label variants; mechanism-level bootstrap or a justified finite-sample alternative specified before registration. Report uncertainty for each outcome and multiplicity policy; no global winner from one graph score.
qualification_rule: No positive model/capability claim without prespecified target-error limits, effect/set calibration and availability, evidence-grounded interpretation and full cost limits. Numeric acceptance thresholds remain unset until decision loss and review budget are supplied.
